verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own docs say it will calculate, file, and pay federal and state payroll taxes with guaranteed accuracy, backed by up to $25,000 in tax penalty protection. That covers state withholding. Nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses employees spread across multiple states or state tax registrations. missing for 10: explicit multi-state employee support, per-state tax registration handling, per-state withholding configuration documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
